snapshots.title: SolidUI setup and coverage
snapshots.content:
Use the official SolidUI installation guide and copy or install registry components with its CLI. Imports in these upstream examples use the docs repository alias ~/registry/ui; adjust paths to your own copied components. The pinned docs source uses Tailwind CSS 4, even though some public setup examples still describe v3.

Verified preview coverage: Button, Accordion, Progress Circle. Other components and variants have not been mirrored.
